source.citation: IMGW-PIB, public hydrological data, station 150160180 Kłodzko on the Nysa Kłodzka: daily values codz_2010_01..12.csv, monthly characteristics mies_2010.csv, half-year and annual characteristics polr_Q_2010.csv (rows of the station in tests/fixtures/imgw_klodzko/, IMGW-PIB_ATTRIBUTION.txt)
source.locator: hydrological year 2010: the monthly mean discharges (MIES, extremum code 2) of November 2009 to October 2010 and the annual mean SQ = 19.1 m3/s (POLR, half-year code 15, extremum code 2), printed to three significant digits

conventions: IMGW-PIB prints discharge to three significant digits (Rocznik Hydrologiczny 2022, p. 7): 0.01 m3/s below 10 and 0.1 m3/s from 10 to 99.9; the case takes the coarser 0.1 for the daily values and the means alike
IMGW-PIB's monthly and annual means are those of all observations of the month and the year; the mean of the daily means of a gapless year equals them but for the rounding of the daily values

the coefficients themselves are not published: the case checks the two means they are the quotient of, the annual one day-weighted as Hydrolog takes it (the mean of the twelve published monthly means, 19.13, lies within the rounding as well)
